sleeves.label: US stocks
sleeves.plain: The whole US stock market, or its 500 largest companies, in one fund.

rule.include: total stock market|total market|total u\.?s\.? stock|s&p 500|s&p500|crsp u\.?s\.? total|russell 3000|msci usa|broad market|core s&p total|portfolio s&p 500

sleeves.label: International stocks
sleeves.plain: Large companies in Europe, Japan and other developed markets.

rule.include: developed markets|eafe|international equity|ftse developed|developed international|core msci international|total international|international stock|ex-us|ex us
rule.exclude: dividend|low vol|min(?:imum)? vol|equal|momentum|value|quality|growth|factor|covered|buffer|enhanced|premium|yield|option|leaders|select|high beta|fundamental|multifactor|completion|sector|banks?\b|financial|energy|tech|small|mid[- ]?cap|esg|sustainab|climate|paris|responsible|clean|innovation|active|tactical|strategic|opportunit|emerging|bond|real estate|hedged|leveraged|small|world ex us small

sleeves.label: Emerging-market stocks
sleeves.plain: Companies in China, India, Taiwan, Brazil and other emerging economies.

sleeves.label: US bonds
sleeves.plain: Loans to the US government and US companies; the steadier part of a portfolio.

rule.include: aggregate|total bond|core bond|core u\.?s\.? aggregate|broad market bond|u\.?s\.? bond market|universal bond|core total

sleeves.label: Short-term US Treasuries
sleeves.plain: US government bonds maturing in 1-3 years; small price moves.

rule.include: 1-3 year treasury|short treasury|short-term treasury|short term treasury|1-3 year u\.?s\.? treasury|treasury 1-3

sleeves.label: Inflation-protected bonds (TIPS)
sleeves.plain: US government bonds whose value rises with inflation.

sleeves.label: International bonds, hedged
sleeves.plain: Bonds from other developed countries with the currency risk removed.

rule.include: international bond|global aggregate|ex-us aggregate|total international bond|ex-u\.s\.|international aggregate

sleeves.label: Real estate (REITs)
sleeves.plain: Companies that own apartments, offices, warehouses and cell towers.

sleeves.label: Gold
sleeves.plain: Physical gold held in a vault; tends to hold up in some crises.

sleeves.label: Cash (Treasury bills)
sleeves.plain: US government bills maturing in weeks; almost no ups and downs.

rule.include: 0-3 month|treasury bill|t-bill|1-3 month|ultra short-term treasury|ultra short treasury|3 month treasury

sleeves.label: US small companies
sleeves.plain: Smaller US companies; more growth potential and more risk.

sleeves.label: Long-term US Treasuries
sleeves.plain: US government bonds maturing in 20+ years; move a lot with interest rates.

rule.include: 20\+ year treasury|long-term treasury|long treasury|extended duration treasury|20\+ yr

sleeves.label: US corporate bonds
sleeves.plain: Loans to large US companies; a bit more income than government bonds.

sleeves.label: High-yield bonds
sleeves.plain: Loans to riskier companies; more income, more risk.
